notablePrerequisites: Two out of the first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than Demonic Pact.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief and Demonic Pact trigger.
Resolve the Demonic Pact trigger, choosing the remaining mode other than the fourth.
Resolve the Puca's Mischief trigger, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
